description:
About Our Brand and Products

Derriere Equestrian is a premium British equestrian brand specialising in innovative riding underwear designed to maximise comfort, confidence, and performance in the saddle.

Created by riders, for riders, our products solve real, everyday problems - chaffing, perineal, coyccx and seat bone pain eliminating visible panty lines. We use high quality, technical fabrics combined with flattering, seamless design to ensure riders feel supported both in and out of the saddle.

Our audience spans the UK, USA, and Europe, with a strong presence across social media and a loyal, engaged customer base.

What Makes Us Different

We’re not just another equestrian brand we are problem-led and performance-driven.

  • Purpose-built riding underwear (not repurposed fashion basics)
  • Seamless, invisible designs that actually work under breeches
  • Technical Italian Fabrics - cooling, wicking, antichaffe, 
  • Padded products are also absorbant for period or leaks.
  • Authentic brand rooted in real equestrian life

Our content regularly reaches thousands to millions of views, showing strong conversion potential for affiliates.

How Affiliates Can Earn

We offer a competitive affiliate structure designed to reward performance:

  • Commission on every sale generated through your unique link
  • High conversion rates due to problem-solving products
  • Opportunities for gifted products
  • Potential for long-term paid partnerships for top performers

Our products are easy to promote and resonate strongly with riders, making conversions natural and consistent.

How to Promote Us

We encourage authentic, relatable content that reflects real use:

  • Riding content (training, competitions, yard life)
  • “Get ready with me” / outfit videos
  • Problem vs solution storytelling
  • Lifestyle and countryside content
  • Honest reviews and wear tests

Short-form video (Reels/TikTok) performs particularly well, especially when showcasing comfort and fit in action.

Other Information

  • Global audience (UK, USA, Europe)
  • Strong social media presence across multiple platforms
  • Fast-growing brand with high engagement
  • Content support and collaboration opportunities available
  • Ideal for equestrians, country lifestyle creators, and fashion-forward riders

We’re building a long-term community of affiliates who genuinely love the brand and want to grow with us.
